questions.stem: A charge particle is moving in a uniform magnetic field $(2 \hat{i}+3 \hat{j}) \mathrm{T}$. If it has an acceleration of $(\alpha \hat{i}-4 \hat{j}) \mathrm{m} / \mathrm{s}^2$, then the value of $\alpha$ will be :
questions.solution: Magnetic force, and hence the acceleration it produces, is perpendicular to the magnetic field. Thus $\vec a\cdot\vec B=0$, giving $2\alpha+3(-4)=0$ and $\alpha=6$.
